CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Summer-2020 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Summer-2020 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 2,999 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 3 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: December 2019 to February 2020). These surveys captured 520 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 8 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 535 cards across 49 sites, with 8.6% showing evidence of mouse activity (46 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 204 transects across 49 sites (survey period: December 2019 to February 2020), detecting active burrows in 22.1% of transects (total: 222 active burrows).
